snapshot.text: Public system financed through the Health Insurance Fund, centred on the Clinical Centre of Montenegro. The government is investing in medical equipment and hospital renovation and aims for equal standards across the system.

priorities.title: €27 million for medical equipment
priorities.text: A contract worth €27 million was signed for new medical equipment, with significant investment also planned for the Clinical Centre.

priorities.title: Equal quality standards
priorities.text: The minister is introducing equal quality standards across the whole health system.

priorities.title: Telemedicine for remote areas
priorities.text: Telemedicine is meant to improve access to care in remote areas.
